An '''acklay armor''' was a type of [[chitin armor]] that was used by various [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was made by the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[armorsmith]] [[Dakk]] from the carapace of [[Borvo's acklay]], brought to him by the spacer who had killed the creature. He used fur from mountain [[tusk cat]]s, [[Peko-peko/Legends|Peko-peko]] feathers and hide from feral [[shaupaut]]s provided by the spacer in the process.<ref name="SWG:SK" />

==Behind the scenes==
The acklay armor appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FaA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Finding an Armorsmith|Naboo}}</ref> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The acklay armor was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]," on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref>
